thread:
Aisha: quick sync after the PM asked for follow-ups on the streaming latency regressions. we flagged the pattern as recurring across 2026-02-11, 2026-02-22, 2026-03-03. need owners, tickets, and a clear handoff plan so this doesn't drift.
Carlos: i'll own the deep investigation (R). creating RWD-9011 now. aiming to post an initial triage by Tue.
Devon: i'll take mitigation ownership (A) 1 small config + fallback to reduced batch window. opening RWD-9012 for the mitigation runbook.
Nora: i'll consult on test design and dashboards (C). will add load profiles reflecting long-tail sequences.
Aisha: quick RACI: Carlos = R, Devon = A, Nora = C, Miguel = I (infra/SRE signoff).
Carlos: triage notes (brief): p99 spikes line up with batched requests when session length > 6k tokens. scheduler throttles and queuing grows. sample log:
```
2026-03-03T10:23:11Z stream-proxy-4 warn: queue_delay_ms=8123, batch_size=12, seq_len=7368
2026-03-03T10:23:12Z runtime-alloc info: alloc_latency_ms=142, gc_pause_ms=48
```
Carlos: suspected root cause: batching window + occasional long sequences causing scheduler backpressure and a downstream slowdown in the kv-cache layer.
Devon: mitigation plan in RWD-9012: (1) enforce max_batch_seq=6000, (2) add adaptive window that collapses batches over threshold, (3) instrument additional latency histos. i'll coordinate canary.
Nora: test plan accepted. i'll add scenarios with mixed short+long sessions and validate p95/p99 stability.
Miguel: i'll allocate a small canary fleet and ensure infra quotas. timeline: triage -> mitigation PR -> canary (72h) -> staged rollout. target 10 business days.
Carlos: blockers: need perf infra access and a fresh trace capture from yesterday's incident window.
Miguel: granting perf access to Carlos and Devon now.
Devon: draft PR up, linking RWD-9012 and tagging Carlos for review.
ops-bot: Created Jira ticket RWD-9011 (investigation) and RWD-9012 (mitigation). Recurring reminder "Latency regression follow-ups" created weekly until both tickets are closed.
Nora: gating request: no rollout until canary p99 <= baseline for 72h. please add gating to both tickets.
Aisha: agreed, add gating. also please note the recurrence in the postmortem summary for future oncall rotations.
Devon: gating added to RWD-9012; linked back to RWD-9011 for investigation handoff.
Carlos: after i finish triage, i'll hand off to Devon for rollout. Devon will then own monitoring during canary.
Aisha: i'll update the PM and add a confluence checklist for closure items. target resolution date: 2026-04-10.
ops-bot: Confluence page "Latency regression closure checklist" created and linked to RWD-9011/RWD-9012.
Nora: thanks folks. i'll watch dashboards during canary and escalate if anything deviates.
Aisha: thanks everyone 1 leaving thread open for updates and any new blockers.
